 Key points
 The Labour Bureau said the All-India CPI-IW rose 1.1 points to 155.5 in September 2026 
 Year-on-year CPI-IW inflation was 5.57%, up from 2.79% in September 2025 
 On nine months' data so far, the DA formula for 1 January 2027 works out to 66%, against the 63% now in force — not yet an order 
 Food & Beverages rose most among groups; Housing and Fuel & Light were unchanged 
 Advertisement
 Chandigarh, 31 October: The All-India Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers rose 1.1 points to 155.5 in September 2026, with year-on-year inflation at 5.57%, the Labour Bureau said on 30 October.
 The index, compiled from retail prices collected from 317 markets across 88 industrially important centres, had stood at 154.4 in August 2026. “The All-India CPI-IW for September, 2026 increased by 1.1 points and stood at 155.5 points,” the release said. Year-on-year inflation was 2.79% in September 2025.
 Among the groups that make up the index, Food & Beverages rose the most, from 161.3 to 163.5, the release said. Pan, Supari, Tobacco & Intoxicants and Clothing & Footwear also rose. Housing and Fuel & Light did not move, staying at 143.0 and 160.0.
 What it means for DA from January 2027
 Central government Dearness Allowance is fixed from the average CPI-IW of the twelve months before the change — January to December for the revision due on 1 January. September 2026 is the ninth of those twelve months.
 On the nine months published so far, the average works out to 151.32. Run through the DA formula, that average gives 66%, against the 63% of basic pay now in force since July 2026. This is what the formula gives on the data available so far, not an order — October, November and December 2026 are still to be published. The release does not say whether DA from 1 January 2027 will in fact rise, or by how much.
 The same index also feeds Industrial DA for Central Public Sector Enterprise staff on 2017 pay scales, which is set every quarter from a three-month average. September 2026 is the first of the three months — September to November — that will fix CPSE IDA for January–March 2027. CPSE IDA is currently 59.1% for October–December 2026.
 Bank employees’ DA, fixed separately under the 12th Bipartite Settlement, is 27.83% of pay for August–October 2026.
 The CPI-IW measures prices only for industrial workers, not the general retail inflation figure that applies to all households, and this release gives no centre-wise or state-wise breakup.
 The Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers, on the 2016=100 series, is released every month by the Labour Bureau and is the basis on which both DA and IDA are revised. Readers tracking their own DA can work out the figure with the DA calculator , and PSU staff can check IDA with the CPSE/PSU salary calculator .
 Source: Labour Bureau, Ministry of Labour & Employment — Press Release, Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers (2016=100) – September, 2026, F.No. 5/1/2021-CPI, 30 October 2026.

 Critical AdSense behaviour: adsbygoogle.push({}) does NOT bind to
 a specific . It says "process the next unbound in DOM
 order." So if you push N times, AdSense binds the first N 
 slots it finds.
 Live investigation (2026-05-29) showed the right sidebar still
 loading late on indianpaycalculator.in. DOM order of :
 1. LEFT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-left)
 2-5. Display banners (4× AdBanner inside page content)
 6. RIGHT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-right, after main slot)
 7. Mobile anchor (StickyAnchorAd at body end)
 Previously this script pushed twice (one per sidebar). Those 2
 pushes bound LEFT + Display#1, NOT LEFT + RIGHT. The other 5
 slots only got bound as AdBanner.client:visible islands hydrated
 on scroll — meaning the right sidebar was bound 6th, after the
 user scrolled past every in-page banner. That's the "right side
 opens very late" complaint.
 Fix: push once per SSR'd ad slot. AdSense binds them all in DOM
 order at body parse end — no React hydration wait, no scroll-to-
 view wait. Subsequent React useEffect pushes (from AdUnit /
 StickyAnchorAd) become no-ops since the AdUnit effect skips when
 data-adsbygoogle-status is already set. --> component was removed 2026-05-29 to eliminate the
 duplicate-anchor conflict where both the manual slot 4961033893 and
 Auto Anchor would compete on mobile, causing one to fail to fill. -->
